title: Module coefficient clause of hypercover cohomology
statement: The module coefficient clause of thm-weil-pbc-hypercover-cohomology: for every qcqs scheme X, q and ring R, FiniteSplitEtaleHypercover.IsCohomologyColimit (ModuleCat R) q (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat R)) 0 ⋙ Etale.cohomology (ModuleCat R) X q).

proof.text: Dualize Mathlib simplicial chain homotopy to the alternating coface complex of module sections. Homotopic refinements induce identical cohomology transformations; extend to the generated homotopy equivalence relation.

Use the actual injective-resolution comparison and arbitrary-ring injective-row acyclicity to construct the natural refinement-compatible cocone to derived terminal sections, then transport it through the canonical etale-cohomology isomorphism.
Bottom-row finite-refinement descent gives surjectivity onto every comparison cohomology class and local killing of every comparison kernel.

Given an arbitrary compatible cocone, choose a representative for a class. Common refinements and local kernel killing show the chosen image is independent of the representative. Common refinements also prove addition and scalar compatibility. This defines an R-linear map; representative coverage proves its uniqueness and all cocone equations.
